nextGame.note: Saturday afternoon road game in Houston. One o'clock our time. Tulane has won four games and lost five. Rice has won four games and lost five too. Tulane needs two more wins to reach a bowl game.

news.headline: Tulsa routs Tulane 60-10 at Homecoming
news.summary: Tulsa led 32-0 at halftime and Tulane never got going, losing by 50 points in front of the Homecoming crowd at Yulman Stadium. It is the worst conference loss Tulane has ever had, and the Green Wave are now four wins and five losses.

news.headline: Tulane's athletic director calls the loss unacceptable
news.summary: David Harris, who runs sports at Tulane, put out a statement Saturday night saying he was embarrassed and that losing by 50 points was unacceptable. He did not announce any changes to the coaching staff.

news.headline: Tulane punter William Hudlow is up for a national award
news.summary: Hudlow is one of 65 players nominated for the Burlsworth Trophy, which goes to the best player who started college without a scholarship. He averages 47 yards a punt, the best in his conference.

nextGame.note: Saturday evening road game in Lexington, Kentucky. A quarter past five our time. Florida has won five games and lost four and needs one more win to reach a bowl game.

news.headline: Oklahoma beats Florida 23-7 in Gainesville
news.summary: Florida scored one touchdown, in the second quarter, and did not score again. The Gators have lost four of their last five games and are five wins and four losses.

news.headline: Sumrall explains the fourth-down call that went wrong
news.summary: Behind 13-7 late in the third quarter, Florida passed up a short field goal and threw on fourth down from the Oklahoma 17. Oklahoma caught the ball instead, and Coach Jon Sumrall said afterward his offense simply did not play well enough to win.

news.headline: Florida plans to start Tramell Jones at quarterback
news.summary: ESPN reported Thursday that Jones will start Saturday night against Oklahoma instead of Aaron Philo. Florida has not announced it, and Philo was pulled from the Georgia game after two interceptions.

nextGame.note: Saturday night road game in Baton Rouge, about an hour up the road. Half past six our time. Texas has won seven games and lost two. LSU has won six and lost three.

news.headline: Texas beats Missouri 34-20 behind Arch Manning
news.summary: Texas trailed most of the afternoon in Columbia and then scored 21 points in a row to win. Arch Manning completed 28 of his 38 passes for 297 yards and three touchdowns and did not throw an interception.

news.headline: Hollywood Smothers is out for the rest of the season
news.summary: Reports Thursday said the Texas running back tore a ligament in his knee and will not play again this year. He ran for 283 yards and two touchdowns, second most on the team.

news.headline: Colin Simmons may play Saturday at Missouri
news.summary: Texas listed its best defensive player as questionable on the conference injury report Wednesday night. He has missed the last two games with a sprained ankle, and the decision may not come until game time.

nextGame.note: Sunday home game in the Superdome against Cleveland. It was today at noon, and the Saints won 23-22 in overtime. They were behind 13-9 with a minute to go, scored to take the lead, gave up a tying field goal with eight seconds left, then won it in overtime.

news.headline: Saints beat Cleveland 23-22 in overtime
news.summary: Tyler Shough threw a 15-yard touchdown to Juwan Johnson in overtime, and the Saints held on when Cleveland scored at the very end but missed its two-point try. It is the Saints' first home win of the season, and they are now three wins and five losses.

news.headline: Alvin Kamara is set to play Sunday
news.summary: Kamara practiced in full on Friday and the Saints gave him no injury designation for the Cleveland game, after he rested his back on Wednesday. Running back C.J. Donaldson is out with a shoulder injury and a concussion, and rookie receiver Jordyn Tyson is questionable for what would be his first NFL game.

news.headline: Cleveland rules out Deshaun Watson for Sunday
news.summary: Browns coach Todd Monken said Friday that his quarterback will not play in the Superdome because of a concussion. Rookie Shedeur Sanders will start against the Saints instead.

news.headline: Peyton Belcher had 6 kills against Gannon
news.summary: Peyton was back on the court Saturday night for the first time since October 23. She played three of the four sets and had 6 kills on 23 swings with 3 errors, plus a block at the net.

news.headline: IUP finishes first in its half of the conference
news.summary: IUP won 12 of its 14 conference matches, one more than Gannon, and finished on top. That earns the Crimson Hawks a home playoff match on Wednesday night.

news.headline: Gannon beats IUP in four sets
news.summary: IUP won the first set 27-25 and then lost the next three to end the regular season. The Crimson Hawks finished with 21 wins and 5 losses.

news.headline: Cody Bellinger wins the Platinum Glove
news.summary: Bellinger won the Platinum Glove, which goes to the best fielder in the American League. He also won a Gold Glove for left field after saving 21 runs with his defense, more than any other left fielder in the league.

news.headline: Cody Bellinger is up for a Silver Slugger Award
news.summary: Bellinger was named Thursday as one of nine American League outfielders in the running for the award that goes to the best hitter at each position. He was an All-Star this year and hit 17 home runs, and the winners are announced November 17.

news.headline: Cam Schlittler is a finalist for the Cy Young Award
news.summary: Schlittler won 14 games and lost 6, and no pitcher in the American League gave up fewer runs. The award for the league's best pitcher is handed out November 11.

nextGame.note: First round of the state playoffs, on the road in Shreveport. That is a long drive, about five hours from New Orleans. Warren Easton is the 21st seed and Evangel is the 12th. The day and the kickoff time have not been set yet. First-round games are played Thursday, Friday or Saturday this week.

news.headline: Warren Easton makes the playoffs and will travel to Shreveport
news.summary: The state playoff brackets came out Sunday. Warren Easton is the 21st seed and plays at Evangel in Shreveport, which is the 12th seed.

news.headline: Bonnabel beats Warren Easton 29-28
news.summary: The Eagles lost by one point at home Thursday night in the last game of their regular season. Warren Easton finishes the year 4-6, and the state playoff pairings are not out yet.

news.headline: John Ehret beats Warren Easton 35-18
news.summary: Warren Easton lost Thursday night in Marrero. It was the Eagles' first district loss and it ended a four-game winning streak, and it drops them from first place in the district to third.
